name: Alcañices (Spain)
description: Red field with a white cross throughout, charged with yellow castles at the upper hoist and lower fly, a white scimitar at the upper fly and a white lion at the lower hoist.
history: The full council of Alcañices, in session on 22 July 2000, agreed to approve the heraldic arms and municipal flag, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 4 August 2000; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a red cloth with a full white cross of a seventh of the width, with a yellow castle masoned black in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters, a white scimitar in the upper fly quarter and a white lion in the lower hoist quarter.
